IMD forecasts heavy rain in parts of Telangana on Sept 11
IMD forecasts heavy rain in parts of Telangana on Sept 11
The weather system developing over the Bay of Bengal is expected to enhance monsoon activity
By -  Newsmeter Network
Published on : 10 Sept 2026 9:56 AM

Hyderabad: India Meteorological Department (IMD) has forecast heavy rain at isolated places in parts of east and northeast Telangana on September 11.

IMD said a low-pressure area is likely to develop over the north Bay of Bengal and adjoining areas.

According to the Meteorological Centre, Hyderabad, an upper-air cyclonic circulation persists over the North Bay of Bengal and adjoining Bangladesh coast, extending up to 5.8 km above mean sea level. Under its influence, a low-pressure area is likely to form over the North Bay of Bengal and the neighbourhood by September 10.

The IMD has warned of heavy rainfall at isolated places in some eastern and northeastern districts of Telangana on Friday, September 11.

The districts likely to be affected include Bhadradri Kothagudem, Mulugu, Jayashankar Bhupalpally, Warangal, Hanamkonda, Mahabubabad, Komaram Bheem Asifabad, Mancherial, Nirmal, Nizamabad, Jagtial, Peddapalli, Rajanna-Sircilla and Kamareddy.

The rest of the state is also expected to receive light to moderate rainfall at isolated places on September 11, with the possibility of thunderstorms accompanied by gusty winds of 30-40 kmph at isolated locations.

The weather system developing over the Bay of Bengal is expected to enhance monsoon activity over Telangana. The IMD has already issued a heavy-rain warning for Telangana for September 11, along with warnings for thunderstorms, lightning and strong surface winds.

The IMD has forecast light to moderate rain at isolated places in the state on September 10, while rainfall activity is expected to increase in several districts on September 11.

Hyderabad, meanwhile, is likely to see partly cloudy skies with one or two spells of rain or thundershowers on September 11, but no specific heavy-rain warning has been issued for the city.

title: IMD Forecasts Heavy Rainfall in Bihar, Jharkhand, Odisha and Several Other States - News On AIR
article_text: The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has forecast heavy rainfall over Bihar, Jharkhand, Gangetic West Bengal, Odisha, Arunachal Pradesh, Assam, Meghalaya, Nagaland, Manipur, Mizoram and Tripura today. The Met Department has predicted thunderstorms accompanied by lightning and gusty winds over the Andaman and Nicobar Islands, Andhra Pradesh, Tamil Nadu, Puducherry and Karaikal. According to IMD, Coastal Andhra Pradesh, Kerala and Mahe are expected to experience hot and humid weather today.
